title: fix(sbom): bind package audits to candidate source inputs
summary: Package SBOM audits bind to candidate source rather than stale environment inputs.
details: Bind selected package/version and project/lock/Make/helper inputs, export frozen offline closures and promote output only after audit and source rechecks.
Retain failed output for diagnosis; declared-input provenance does not authenticate an upstream repository or claim a real vulnerability-service scan.
